Past that S3 charges $0.09/GB and R2 still charges $0.

Decentralized storage network: files encrypted, split, and distributed across independent nodes. S3-compatible gateway. Edge-optimized downloads (retrieves from nearest nodes). Integrated with Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and the broader Azure ecosystem. The Founders Hub program ($150K credits) can offset costs for startups. Best for Azure-committed organizations.

Free tier: 10 GB storage, 10 GB egress, 50,000 API requests/month. Always Free — does not expire. S3-compatible API. Egress at $0.0085/GB is the cheapest of any hyperscaler. Combined with Oracle’s 200 GB block volume Always Free, it’s competitive for budget builds. Often overlooked but generous.
AWS S3: the storage free tier expires after 12 months, the egress allowance does not

S3’s 5 GB free tier is part of the 12-month AWS Free Tier, not Always Free. After 12 months you pay for stored bytes from the first one. What does not expire is the egress allowance: AWS S3 gives every account its first 100 GB of internet egress each month free, on an account of any age, aggregated across all AWS services and regions, so a project serving under 100 GB a month pays nothing for bandwidth however old the account is. The 12-month trap is the storage, and it catches developers who set up a project during the trial and forget about it. Azure Blob Storage’s 5 GB of storage has the same 12-month limit. GCS and Oracle are Always Free.
